item.title: Schnaubelt seeks clarity on new Konos Open Electorate ahead of 2027 election
item.description: Member for Namatanai, Walter Schnaubelt, issued a stern grievance during today’s Parliament sitting, accusing the Boundaries Commission of stalling the formalization of the proposed Konos Open Electorate. Schnaubelt expressed frustration that despite meeting all technical and population requirements, the Commission has yet to provide a final confirmation, leaving the district’s service delivery in limbo as the 2027 General Elections approach. item.title: Building a new National Industry for PNG
item.description: The Central Lime and Central Cement Projects represent one of PNG’s most significant downstream processing initiatives. For the first time, PNG will be able to produce high quality quicklime, clinker and cement domestically, reducing the country’s reliance on imports, strengthening economic sovereignty and keeping more value locally. item.description: The Walk The Talk Association (WTTA) has reinforced its commitment to promoting sustainable food security and economic empowerment following a successful community engagement program in Rigo District.
